tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the charter exhibit, gesturing at each charter panel and stopping at human-reserved action signage.
tasks.terrain: Flat paved plaza around the Broad Street pump replica; watch for curb edges and the pump memorial base.
success: Visits all 5 exhibit waypoints in order
Maintains >=0.4 m clearance from the pump replica
Speech/gesture completes within 300 s
safety_stops: E-stop if obstacle <0.3 m ahead
Stop speech if a visitor blocks the path
Battery <20% triggers return-to-dock
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the tour script and any updates to charter text before tours begin.

tasks.goal: Circle the Broad Street pump replica, capturing imagery of plaque text and structural condition for the Progress Tracker.
tasks.terrain: Cobblestone-style paving around the memorial; the cast-iron pump body is the primary obstacle to avoid contact with.
success: Completes 360-degree orbit at 1 m radius
Plaque photos readable (blur metric below threshold)
Zero contact events with the pump
safety_stops: Abort if slip estimate exceeds threshold on cobbles
Stop if a pedestrian enters 1 m bubble
Halt imaging if operator pause requested
tasks.human_in_loop: A person reviews and approves the inspection summary before it is published to the Progress Observatory.

tasks.goal: Fetch bound research summaries from indexed shelves and deliver them to the Evidence Monitor workstation.
tasks.terrain: Indoor lab flooring; shelf bases and rolling carts create narrow aisles requiring careful base planning.
success: Picks 5 of 5 requested items
Drop rate below 5%
Delivery within 420 s
safety_stops: Release grasp if force exceeds limit
Stop if a human enters the workspace zone
Pause on lost localization >5 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A librarian-agent supervisor confirms item selection; only people may archive or discard records.

tasks.goal: Carry printed proposal drafts from the drafter station to the human review desk without performing any enactment steps.
tasks.terrain: Thresholds between indoor zones and the outdoor plaza; wet London pavement near the pump increases slip risk.
success: Delivers payload to review desk within 240 s
Payload upright the whole trip (tilt <15 deg)
Route keeps >=0.5 m from stair edges
safety_stops: Self-right and stop on slip detected
Refuse to hand off except at the review desk
Stop in heavy rain per operator weather flag
tasks.human_in_loop: A human reviewer accepts each delivery and casts any final vote; the robot never enacts proposals.

tasks.goal: Adjust the height and angle of the progress dashboard panel mount so metrics displays align for seated and standing viewers.
tasks.terrain: Fixed pedestal mount beside the display wall; cable run behind the panel is a pinch hazard.
success: Panel angle within 2 deg of target
Applied wrench below 40 N throughout
Cycle completes in under 180 s
safety_stops: Stop on force/torque threshold breach
Halt if a person enters the workspace envelope
Disable if joint speed exceeds scaled limit
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator approves target angles and confirms which metrics go on public display.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude scan of the Operations Deck overhead cable routing and report loose fixtures to the Task Router.
tasks.terrain: Indoor ceiling clutter with lighting rigs and suspended signage; strong HVAC updrafts near vents to model.
success: Covers 90% of planned scan volume
Holds position within 10 cm in hover
Returns to pad with >15% battery
safety_stops: Cut motors and land if position estimate diverges
Land if any human raises a hand within 1 m
Return home at 20% battery
tasks.human_in_loop: A person clears each flight and approves any maintenance ticket raised from findings.

tasks.goal: Assemble modular ballot-box podium hardware for the human voting station with sub-millimeter part placement.
tasks.terrain: Workbench surface with loose fasteners; parts tray edges constrain grasp approach vectors.
success: 8 of 8 parts placed within 1 mm tolerance
Zero dropped parts
Assembly completes within 600 s
safety_stops: Reflex stop on contact force >10 N
Pause if hands detected in workspace
Stop if grasp confidence <0.7
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies the podium and controls the voting hardware keys; the robot only assembles.

tasks.goal: Survey the plaza around the pump replica to map accessibility for steward site visits, logging surface types and gradients.
tasks.terrain: Mixed paved plaza with cobbles near the memorial, kerb drops at street edges, and pedestrian foot traffic typical of Soho.
success: Covers the full plaza perimeter route
Terrain classification accuracy >=85% vs ground truth
Gradient map complete with no gaps >2 m
safety_stops: Stop for pedestrians within 2 m
Halt at kerb drops >10 cm
Return to base on GNSS loss >30 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the published accessibility map before it informs any visit planning.
